mechanism.claim: Within a volatile completed BTC block, turnover concentrated into a few auctions on only one return side reflects episodic sponsored price discovery in that direction. Follow the side with the greater count-normalized within-side turnover concentration for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of normalized up-bar turnover concentration minus normalized down-bar turnover concentration
mechanism.why_distinct: Unsigned turnover HHI pools all auctions, sign entropy and run asymmetry ignore turnover, return-volume covariance measures linear co-movement, and range-participation polarity weights directional mass. HVDTCAR compares two separately normalized within-side turnover distributions and uses no endpoint gate, flow classification, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while directional concentration separation enters its upper 30%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily side-conditioned turnover-concentration onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent five-minute groups from 480 bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_return: log(group close/group open), finite and strict nonzero for classified bars
features.five_minute_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume in group, finite nonnegative
features.side_partition: strict positive-return and strict negative-return groups; each side requires at least two groups and strict positive turnover
features.directional_concentration_contrast: normalized up concentration minus normalized down concentration, finite strict nonzero
features.concentration_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(directional_concentration_contrast) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: separate count-normalized concentration of turnover within positive and negative auctions

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no partition, concentration normalization, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
